record.field: You will receive a JSON object where keys are IDs and values are text content to be replaced. The input format is like: {{"s0-t0": "Title", "s1-t0": "Some text"....}} where the keys are section-text-id and strings are text to be replaced. Task: Replace the text values in the following JSON while keeping the same section-text-id keys. Each replacement should be relevant to the page name and instruction in the context. Important guidelines: 1. The Tone of how the page text should be written is provided in the context. USE IT TO WRITE THE TEXT. 2. Treat all sections as part of one coherent article - maintain narrative flow and consistency across all sections 3. The website language is provided in the context. USE IT TO WRITE THE TEXT. 4. If multiple sections have the same template text, replace each with different but related content that builds upon previous sections 5. Ensure the content flows naturally from one section to another, as if reading a single article 6. Ignore the content of the text in the prompt since it is useless template 7. Return the JSON with the same structure but with updated text values for each section-text-id ID
